# ElizaOS Daily Digest: August 14, 2026

Development on August 14 focused on stabilizing cloud infrastructure and advancing the "phone-first" personal agent experience. Key achievements include the production release of voice features with improved recovery mechanisms and the standardization of UI components across the cloud dashboard.

## ✅ Completed Work

### Voice & Infrastructure Stability
*   **Production Voice Features:** Promoted responsive phone voice features to production, including new barge-in support and dynamic greetings ([elizaos/eliza#19655](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19655), [elizaos/eliza#19660](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19660)).
*   **Voice Session Reliability:** Implemented robust STT transport recovery to ensure call continuity during provider errors ([elizaos/eliza#19548](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19548)).
*   **Deployment Pipeline Hardening:** Resolved infrastructure issues, including fixes for Hetzner firewall parsing and Railway DNS handoff logic ([elizaos/eliza#19652](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19652), [elizaos/eliza#19647](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19647)).

### Personal Identity & UI/UX
*   **"Phone-First" Personal Eliza:** Shipped the personal agent framework, enabling persistent identity across web, desktop, and mobile clients ([elizaos/eliza#19354](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19354), [elizaos/eliza#19511](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19511)).
*   **Persona Consistency:** Added in-character failure templates to ensure agents maintain their persona during rate limits or configuration errors ([elizaos/eliza#19569](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19569)).
*   **Dashboard & Visual Refinement:** Standardized cloud dashboard layouts and improved `elizaresearch` particle-face animations for better mobile responsiveness ([elizaos/eliza#19481](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19481), [elizaos/eliza#19482](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19482), [elizaos/eliza#19489](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19489), [elizaos/eliza#19493](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19493), [elizaos/eliza#19516](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/19516)).
